name: ShiroKuro Iede Gyaru - Tomete Kuretara Nandemo Suru yo ♥
original_name: シロクロ家出ギャル 泊めてくれたらなんでもするよ♥
source:
* They're not homeless, but home is... a love hotel!?
* It's not prostitution... it's paying rent with gratitude!

Atsushi, a well-to-do salaryman, met a pair of runaway JKs.

One had a malibu tan and bleach blonde hair,
she went by "Sera" and was a prototypical kurogal.
The other was a pale, daddy-pays-for-private-school girl
with a saucy flirtiness, her nickname was "Juri".

After a night of drinking Atsushi woke up in a hotel room
with Juri's porcelain skin bouncing lewdly in front of his eyes.

They had a good romp.

When it was time for Atsushi to go, the girls pleaded.
They were looking for a "benefactor".

He would have loved to bring them home, but what if a nosy neighbor
got the wrong idea? He'd be evicted! His life would be over!

So he forked out several nights worth of pay
to live at the love hotel. Hooray! Now, about repaying him...

"You be sure to come around any time, mister landlooooord~"

translation:
* 他们不是无家可归，只是家在……爱情旅馆！？
* 这不是卖淫……而是用感谢来支付房租！

生活富裕的工薪族敦遇见了一对离家出走的女高中生。

一个有着马里布晒黑肤色和漂白金发，自称赛拉，是典型的黑辣妹。
另一个肤色苍白，是由父亲支付私立学校学费的女孩，爱开下流玩笑，昵称朱莉。

喝了一晚酒后，敦在酒店房间醒来，眼前是朱莉白瓷般的皮肤淫荡地弹动。

他们痛快地玩了一场。

敦准备离开时，女孩们恳求他留下。她们正在寻找一个“金主”。

他很想把她们带回家，但要是多管闲事的邻居误会了怎么办？他会被赶出去的！人生就完了！

于是，他掏出几晚的工资，住进了爱情旅馆。太棒了！现在，该怎么偿还他呢……

“房东大人，记得随时过来哦～”
